scheme_name: Ex-Gratia Grant for Disability to CAPF Personnel
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Haryana
Must be a disabled CAPF personnel permanently disabled due to war/operation, operational areas, terrorist activities, natural calamities, etc.
Must have been discharged from service because of the disability
Application must be submitted within three years of the disability onset
benefits_summary: Ex‑gratia grant ranging from ₹15 lakh to ₹35 lakh depending on disability percentage (25‑49%: ₹15 lakh; 50‑74%: ₹25 lakh; 75% and above: ₹35 lakh).
